visual_description: A contemporary open‑plan office bathed in soft natural light from large windows. In the foreground, a mid‑30s employee in a light‑colored button‑down shirt stands slightly turned, his shoulders tense, extending a small black USB flash drive toward a partner seated at a nearby desk. The partner, wearing a dark blazer and a subtle, confident smile, reaches out with one hand to take the drive while his other hand rests on a sleek laptop. The laptop screen shows a generic spreadsheet of colored bars and charts—no readable text—suggesting financial or operational data. A coffee mug, a potted plant, and a few scattered office supplies sit on the desk, grounding the scene in a typical workplace. The camera is positioned just above the employee’s shoulder, looking down at the exchange, with shallow depth of field that keeps the USB drive and the laptop screen sharply in focus while the background blurs slightly. The lighting is even, with gentle shadows that add a hint of tension to the otherwise ordinary office environment. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A professional, realistic photo of a modern open-plan office. A mid-30s employee in a light button-down shirt is handing a small black USB flash drive to a colleague in a dark blazer who is sitting at a desk with a laptop. The mood is professional yet tense. The focus is on the exchange of the USB drive. Natural light, 4:5 aspect ratio, high quality, no readable text on the laptop screen. Ensure the scene is a modern office, not a historical map. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
